name.description: A short handle people tell profiles apart by, e.g. `english-phone`. Nothing checks that it is unique.

provider.description:
The transcription service — an entry of the `transcription-services`
registry, which a contract set extends with a registry file of its
own. `none` for conversations no service transcribes: a chat, or
lines a person types.

languages.description:
The languages the conversation may be in. One fixes the language;
several let the service tell which is being spoken among them.
Absent, the service detects the language itself — which not every
service can do.

idleTimeout.description:
How long a recording transcript may go without a line or gap before
it closes itself, as an ISO 8601 duration. It is checked when the
time is up and again after any activity since, so a quiet
transcript closes between one and two of these after it was last
heard from. Absent, a transcript never closes for being idle.

id.description: Unique identifier — given in the config for a seeded profile, server-generated for one added here.

source.description: Where a record of a config-seeded resource came from. `system`: the deployment's config file, which seeds it once; afterwards it can be changed through the API, but not deleted. `user`: added through the API, and deletable where the API allows it. A client can use it to leave out a delete it would be refused, without trying it first.

offset.description: Number of profiles skipped before this page.

hasNext.description: Whether more profiles are available beyond this page.
